description: Substantive published changes. Dates describe the linked content change, not an automatic build or a stock check.

entries.change: Expanded to eight Tiny models, including a separate M70q Gen 2 reference, with generation-specific memory and unresolved-parts boundaries.
Added cable-and-carrier checks, existing-parts checks and the conditions for avoiding a duplicate kit purchase.
Clarified machine-type parts evidence and the conflict between a PCIe card and a 2.5-inch drive.
Separated two-NVMe storage options from configuration-specific PCIe and SATA fit.
Added complete cable paths, Mac display limits, DisplayLink requirements and missing-parts checks.
Added actual clamp geometry, minimum monitor weight, reinforcement thickness and unknown-fit outcomes.
Separated local NAS, routed, direct and internet paths, with complete port budgets and link-rate ceilings.
Clarified exact pack choices, the WAN/backhaul path and verified buying options.
Added the TS4-versus-newer-dock decision and the limits that a new dock cannot remove.
Paused an unavailable exact listing and distinguished the Original model from a different recalled folding model.
Added a three-generation comparison with keep-or-upgrade decisions, charging, network and cable-path checks.
Added the Link 2 and Pro comparison, including fixed versus motorized framing and computer software limitations.
Added platform-specific feature checks and the differences between a native integration and a Matter bridge.
Added a complete-chain outage plan that separates ISP loss, local-network failure and loss of mains power.
Added exact-generation no-drill mount checks, surface limitations and a reversible installation plan.
Added a two-option ownership calculator with separate first-year and renewal subscriptions, consumables and electricity.
Added moving-knee clearance, chair stability and powered-versus-manual checks without transferring another brand's measurements.
Separated model-specific and grip-style adapters, combined load and unresolved exact-monitor fit.
Identified the RR-60 as a single-sheet scanner and added exact paper-handling and export checks.
Added camera placement, reflection, clamp and power checks, keeping different manufacturers' specifications separate.
Corrected the linked item to an open letter-size file cart and compared it with an enclosed drawer cabinet.
